newsitem.title: USA: Tech Electro to issue up to 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Tech Electro to issue up to 1 mln shares.

text.p: Tech Electro Industries Inc said Friday that its board of has authorized the company to issue up to one million shares of common stock and options to acquire an additional one million shares of common stock in a private placement.

The purchase prices for the shares and options, said the company, will be $1.70 per share, and the options will be exercisable at $2.15 per share for a period of 24 months following issuance. The proceeds of the sale will be used to fund acquisitions by the company.

Tech Electro, through its subsidiaries, imports, distributes and sells batteries, electronic components used to manufacture and assemble high-technology products, such as computers and oil field equipment.
